set.prevailing_wage_basis: SHRA 2026 County Multifamily Lending Policies Section 6.1 (which govern AHO fund loans) state state prevailing wages apply to projects receiving benefits from a governmental entity, with the main exemption being a below-market loan where 40% of units are at 80% AMI for 20 years (Labor Code 1720(c)(5)(E)); an AHO-only loan meeting that test may be exempt, and HOME (12+ units) or CDBG (8+ units) in the stack adds Davis-Bacon. https://www.shra.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026-SHRA-Multifamily-Lending-Policies-County-final.pdf ; https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720

set.prevailing_wage_basis: Labor Code 1720(b)(4) defines payment out of public funds to include fees that are reduced or waived by a political subdivision, so the fee reduction counts as public funds; an otherwise private project is exempt only if the subsidy is de minimis in the context of the project under 1720(c)(3), and the 1720(c)(5)(E) exemption covers below-market loans, not fee waivers. https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720
